claims_check.claim: Area: My Khe Beach / On My Khe Beach

claims_check.claim: Dragon Bridge is 12 minutes by Grab
claims_check.evidence: OSRM car estimate 6.85 km / 8.7 min without traffic (4.4 km straight). Official says 10 min from city heart. 12 min plausible with traffic; mark as unverifiable-to-slightly-high.

claims_check.claim: Hoi An is 30 minutes by car
claims_check.evidence: Corrected Hoi An point (15.8794,108.328): OSRM 21.7 km / 25.8 min without traffic; official site says 20 min. 30 min plausible with traffic.

claims_check.claim: the airport is about 7km away
claims_check.evidence: OSRM 12.5 km / 14.8 min by road (6.3 km straight line). 7 km only matches the straight line; official says 15 min.

claims_check.claim: no rooftop bar
claims_check.evidence: No rooftop bar or pool on official pages.

claims_check.claim: yoga, breathwork, tai chi classes
claims_check.evidence: Breathwork master class, Vinyasa, Hatha, HIIT listed; tai chi appears in Kids Wellness Club; not confirmed for adults.

tia-wellness-resort-da-nang.notes: Official domain tiawellnessresort.com opened directly. Operator/owner not found. Beach distance is nearest OSM coastline vertex from the building point, not a measured walk. Hoi An figures recomputed with corrected coordinates 15.8794,108.3280.
